The '''Junior Galaxy Scouts''' were a group whose members used a two-finger salute. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] entrepreneur [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] once emulated their salute when pledging his honesty to [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]].
